## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and any difference between macOS and Linux.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend regression tests pass using isolated, fictional data.
- [ ] macOS builds; changed controls work in light and dark mode.
- [ ] Linux builds; changed controls work under Tk (headless smoke test where applicable).
- [ ] Shared behavior is covered once in backend tests; platform-specific behavior has focused coverage.
- [ ] Public package validation passes and screenshots contain no private information.

List checks actually run, their results, and anything left for CI or manual verification.

## Compatibility and limitations

Explain persistent-state migrations, scheduling changes, or any new platform dependencies.
For a release, update VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, and relevant user documentation together.
